page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with marginal notes down the right margin. A short catchword ("ossibus") sits at the lower right below the last line. Page number and running head at the top.

main_text.l: tus est Baptismus{a}[?]
DE COENA DOMINI.

l.i: Qua ratione in Cæna Domini admoneris & con-
firmaris, te unici illius sacrificij Christi in cru-
ce oblati, atque omnium eius bonorum partici-

main_text.l: Quód Christus me atq; omnes fideles de
hoc fracto pane edere, & de poculo distributo
bibere iussit, in sui memoriam, addita hac pro-
missione{b}: Primùm, corpus suum non minùs
certò pro me in cruce oblatum ac fractum, &
sanguinem suum pro me fusum esse, quàm
oculis cerno, panem Domini mihi frangi, & pocul-
um mihi communicari. Deinde animam
meam non minùs certò ipsius corpore, quod
pro nobis crucifixum, & sanguine, qui pro no-
bis fusus est, ad vitam æternam ab ipso pasci,
quàm panem & vinum, symbola corporis &
sanguinis domini, è manu ministri accepta,
ore corporis percipio.

l.i: Quid est crucifixum corpus Christi edere,

main_text.l: Est non tantum totam passionem & mor-
tem Christi certa animi fiducia amplexati, ac
per id remissionem peccatorum & vitam
æternam adipisci{c}: sed etiam per S. S. qui simul
in Christo & in nobis habitat, ita sacrosancto
eius corpori magis ac magis vniri{d}, vt quamuis
ipse in cœlo{e}, nos vero in terra simus, nihilo-
minus tamen, caro simus de carne eius, & os de
ossibus

page.notes: Marginal references at the top right ("col.2.11.", "a 2.13.") were tied to the superscript after "Baptismus", whose mark is uncertain. Reference d reads "dio.6.55.66" on the scan and was copied as "Io.6.55.56[?]"; the last digit is doubtful. Note e lines are partly blurred ("A&.1.9.1." may be "Act.1.9.1."). The superscript marks c, d and e are small and were placed by sequence. The final word "ossibus" is printed larger at the lower right and is treated as the catchword.
